provider: Lark / 飞书 Drive via multi-tenant app credentials (the FeiSync pattern)
category: platform storage reached through app credentials

free_tier.stated: 100 GB per Lark tenant. '任意扩容，只要添加 App ID 和 App Secret 就可以免费获得100G空间，单文件250M，简单说就是容量上限取决于你的号数量'

retention.stated: While the tenant persists. No retention clock published

egress.terms: Unmetered in practice; there is no egress line item on the free tier

tooling: FeiSync v1.0.0 by fish2018, Tauri and Rust with a Vue front end, presented on linux.do on 2025-12-28: multi-tenant routing, one-way or two-way cron sync, resumable transfer and an open HTTP API. The underlying API is the Lark Drive open platform v1 at /drive/v1/files
chaining: This is the Google service-account pattern reimplemented for Lark: create N free tenants, register a custom app in each, and FeiSync load-balances writes across them for 100 GB times N in one flat namespace. 250 MB per file is the binding number, not the bytes

limits.value: apps inside one tenant share that tenant's 100 GB, so a second app is not a second quota

identity_cost.detail: a distinct email address or phone number per tenant. Lark has historically required an overseas IP to register outside the mainland, which is a feature here

reliability_note: Two constraints bite: 250 MB per file caps the cold-archive case hard, and app-permission changes break the wrapper. Tenant creation needs a distinct identity each time

evidence.proved: '免费无限扩容，每个账号免费扩容100G，单文件250M' and '不能是同一个企业的不同应用，会共享100G'
'larksuite所谓飞书海外版，必须要海外IP才能注册' '海外ip，会成功'
'Lark 免费用户就有自定域名邮箱、100 GB 存储'

binding_note: 100 GB per tenant multiplies cleanly and the traffic is free, so the only number that shapes a plan is 250 MB per file: the 20 TiB archive becomes 84,000 objects, and the 10 TiB working set 42,000.
notes: The most directly applicable of the app-credential patterns, because tenancy is free and self-service. The 250 MB file cap is what makes it a shard target rather than a store, and that is a job for a chunker rather than a blocker.

aliases: Lark / 飞书 Drive via multi-tenant app credentials (FeiSync pattern)
